Can’t hear it?

  1. Press volume up while the game is playing — on an iPhone the volume buttons change the ringer until something is making sound.
  2. Turn off silent mode: swipe down from the top-right for Control Centre and tap the bell, or press the Action Button on the left edge.
  3. Turn off Focus if one is on.
